1.consolidated_definition: Biciclo pequeño sobre el cual se monta un pie y con el otro pie se impulsa. Se manipula con un manubrio alto.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Pedal bike or push bike is a small bicycle on which one foot is placed and the other foot propels it. It is manipulated with a high handlebar.
